title: K-flat localization of one integral Verdier conclusion
statement: Fix the finite-field datum, prime, separated finite-type scheme, coefficient field and coherent integral dualizing datum of `lem-coef-rational-verdier-datum`. Assume the integral Verdier conclusion for the dualizing object. Then there exists a normalized rational Verdier datum whose signed symmetry is natural on K-flat chain representatives.

proof.text: Keep the integral tensor presentation and signed representative, localize internal-Hom maps on pure tensors, and extend by additivity. Localized delta, evaluation and completion maps provide all rational datum fields. The Koszul representative formula gives the displayed equation on K-flat chain maps.

theorem datum_of_integral_kflat
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (h : IntegralVerdier.Conclusion l E X D hl wE.omega wE.reduction) :
    ∃ A : Datum D l hl X E wE,
      ∀ (P P' Q Q' : CochainComplex (IntegralHom.Modules.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)) ℤ)
        (hP : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P)
        (hP' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P')
        (hQ : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q)
        (hQ' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q')
        (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
        A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)) ≫
            (A.symmetry.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P') (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q')).hom =
          (A.symmetry.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
            A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))
